mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months (measured as the change from t-3mo to t) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates compress equity discount rates and boost valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risk and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high UNRATE periods (UNRATE>5.0%) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the past month signal aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of simultaneous FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive returns over the next 20 trading days as labor market strength supports corporate earnings and consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low UNRATE periods (UNRATE<4.0%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer confidence and weaker economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low HOUST periods (HOUST<1200) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 60 trading days as a contraction in manufacturing signals economic weakness.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low INDPRO periods (INDPRO<100) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 700,000 million dollars, the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 5 trading days due to weak consumer demand and reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low RSAFS periods (RSAFS<700000) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 5 trading days as a contraction in manufacturing signals immediate economic weakness.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low INDPRO periods (INDPRO<100) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
